name: reels-machine
description: Edit vertical Reels from scratch in the terminal with ffmpeg: cut scenes, crop to 9:16, generate a branded cover, find and download royalty-free music (Pixabay, no Content ID) and mux it all in sync. The Reel comes out ready to post. Brand-agnostic — you plug in your own logo, fonts and colors via a config file. Created by Brasa · Tráfego & Mídia.
